global_definition.description: Consolidated definition of the code across all documents. More abstract than individual summaries but anchored in the data.

properties.description: Properties and dimensions of the category. Empty array if no clear properties are identified.

name.description: Name of the property as a noun (e.g. 'intensity', 'frequency', 'context').

description.description: What varies in this dimension and between what values.

gradient.description: Range of variation. E.g.: 'low → high', 'explicit → implicit'. Empty string if not applicable.

evidence_doc_count.description: In how many documents evidence of this property is observed.

internal_types.description: Sub-patterns or profiles that emerge within the category. Empty array if no clear internal types.

label.description: Label of the type or profile.

description.description: What distinguishes this type from others within the category.

distinguishing_property.description: Property that differentiates this type. Empty string if there is no unique property.

conditions.description: Circumstances under which the category manifests. Empty array if no conditions are identified.

type.description: structural: stable context condition. contingent: variable or situational condition.

suggested_action.description: none: robust category. enrich: add properties/dimensions. subdivide: create subcategories. divide: separate into distinct categories.

suggested_action_rationale.description: Justification of the suggested action, referencing evidence from the summaries.
